visual.description: Phase 1 (~6s): The frozen race chart from scene-019 holds. The '4 of 6' tally is visible. Phase 2 (~6s): Chart slowly darkens to 20% opacity. Large text fades in center: 'But cheaper… for whom?' in Montserrat Bold 64px, Accent Cream. The ellipsis after 'cheaper' should appear with a 500ms delay — a typographic pause. Phase 3 (~6s): The question text fades, replaced by: 'What if we change the ruler?' in Montserrat 36px. Below it, three ruler icons representing different deflators emerge: 'Median Wage ✓', 'CPI ?', 'Min Wage ?'

phase2.text: What if we change the ruler?

notes: THE PIVOT MOMENT. This scene bridges the wage-deflated race chart and the lens switch reveal. The 'for whom?' text is the emotional hinge of the entire video. Let it breathe — the two 1000ms breaks mean 2 full seconds of visual pause. The text should be the ONLY thing on screen during phase 2 — dark background, large type, no distractions. The question mark after 'CPI' and 'Min Wage' in phase 3 creates anticipation. 8-frame crossfade between phases.
